capabilities: Convert Markdown files to mind maps via right-click
Edit mind maps in an editor opened from the sidebar
Copy mind map images and insert them into Markdown
Save and sync mind map files with an mxmind.com account
extras: The README warns that the plugin uses the mxmind.com remote service and that some features (saving, syncing) require an mxmind.com account; it includes a Privacy section whose content is not shown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view Markdown files as mind maps or to create and edit mind maps inside the vault.
summary: Mind map plugin that converts Markdown files into mind maps and provides an embedded mind map editor.
